title: WoDX Voices
description: World of Darkness Expanded: NPCs speak aloud, each in a steady voice of its own, heard only by the people who see the line: WoDX NPC talk cards and the Storyteller's own lines in character. Kokoro renders each line once on the Storyteller's computer, offline; the browser's own speech is the fallback. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.

recommends.reason: Voices reads WoDX NPC's talk cards.
